subject: Demo recap and proposed trial timetable — BlueHarbor Analytics evaluation
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@blueharbor.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.s@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: demo recap + proposed evaluation outline

Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed next-step plan to move to a short trial: 

What we demoed (high level):
- Inference throughput and predictable latency for your batch and streaming use-cases
- Prefix caching and KV re-use examples for query-heavy endpoints
- Console dashboards for token-level cost breakdowns and per-model SLAs

BlueHarbor signals we captured during the call:
1) Primary goal: reduce average inference cost for near-real-time enrichment pipelines while keeping 95th pct latency <120ms.
2) Key datasets: 2M historical enrichment events/month; peak concurrency ~180 rps; 5–10 turn conversational flow per session.
3) Security: need SOC2 evidence and VPC/private deployment notes (you asked about audit logs and KMS).

Proposed short trial (3 weeks) — draft scope:
- Week 0: onboarding + data ingest sample (we'll attach a lightweight eval checklist)
- Week 1: baseline run on your sample workload (ours vs. your current endpoint)
- Week 2: iterate on batching/quantization settings; collect quality regressions using your prompt tests
- Week 3: final perf/cost report and go/no-go decision with exec summary

Owners: Redwood: Sofia (trial lead), Ben (performance tuning), Marissa (customer success). BlueHarbor: Tom (project sponsor), Priya (engineering lead).

I attached a preliminary timetable (BH_POCTimetable_v1.xlsx) and an evaluation checklist (blueharbor-eval-checklist.md). Can you confirm the owners and whether a three-week cadence looks reasonable? If so, we'll propose specific calendar slots for an onboarding session next week.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: BH_POCTimetable_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet - proposed timeline), blueharbor-eval-checklist.md (markdown - success criteria + tests)
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@blueharbor.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@blueharbor.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: demo recap + proposed evaluation outline

Thanks Sofia —

On Sat, Feb 14, 2026 at 2:12 PM Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick recap from our side and a proposed next-step plan to move to a short trial...

Appreciate the clear summary. The three-week window is reasonable for us — a couple of clarifications before we lock dates:

- Success criteria: to be explicit on the BlueHarbor side we'd like: 1) cost per enrichment <= 60% of current; 2) 95th pct latency <120ms across our 90% of traffic patterns; 3) no regression on semantic-match F1 for our prompt suite (threshold: within 2% of baseline).
- Data: we will provide a 10k-sample payload (anonymized) and a small prompt test set by Tuesday EOD.
- Security: can you share a short SOC2 summary and list of audit logs fields you capture? We may need that for procurement.

If you can slot onboarding Wednesday or Thursday (US west) next week that works. Priya and I will be on the call.

Thanks —
Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Platform Engineering, BlueHarbor Analytics
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Follow-up: demo recap + proposed evaluation outline

Sofia —

I reviewed the timetable you attached. A couple of practical notes from the tuning side:
- We'll start with a quantized 8-bit variant for the baseline to get a quick cost comparison, then run float16 for quality checks.
- Need a sample of the 95th pct request length distribution (token counts) — if BlueHarbor can include that with the payload it speeds things up.
- For the SOC2 summary, I can pull the SOC2 one-pager and the audit-log field list (should cover request_id, model_id, user_id hash, timestamp, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms).

I'll prep the env templates and a runbook tonight so onboarding is plug-and-play for Priya.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@blueharbor.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.s@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: demo recap + proposed evaluation outline

Tom / Priya —

Great — thanks for the clarity on success criteria. That's exactly the level of detail we need.

Actions I've scheduled:
- Wed 18 Feb 10:00–11:00 PT: Onboarding + environment setup (Sofia, Ben, Priya, Tom) — invite sent.
- Thu 19 Feb: BlueHarbor drops 10k anonymized payload + token-length distribution CSV to the shared Drive link (see related links).
- Week of 23 Feb: Baseline runs and initial perf report (Ben will lead tuning).
- Week of 2 Mar: Final cost/quality write-up and exec summary for the decision.

I attached the same timetable and checklist again. Ben will upload the SOC2 one-pager and audit-log fields to the Drive before the onboarding.

If these slots work for you, we'll treat Wed's call as the official trial kickoff and update the HubSpot deal record (BH-4931) with milestones.

Best —
Sofia
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Follow-up: demo recap + proposed evaluation outline

Noted — I added internal owners to the onboarding invite and created a checklist in the CS workspace. I'll own executive follow-ups and procurement coordination (license/PO). Ben — ping me when the SOC2 packet is on Drive and I'll attach it to the HubSpot record.

Marissa
